title: Reconnect Button
description: Adds a "Reconnect" button to the disconnection screen. Quickly jump back into the last server!
body:
# 🔄 Reconnect Button

A simple, lightweight client-side mod that adds a functional **"Reconnect"** button to the Minecraft disconnection screen. No more annoying clicks back to the multiplayer menu just to rejoin!

---

## ✨ Features

* **One-Click Rejoin:** Adds a working "Reconnect" button right under the "Back to Server List" button.
* **Smart IP Saving:** Uses a custom manager to remember the exact server IP you tried to join, preventing vanilla Minecraft from clearing it on unexpected kicks.
* **Multi-Language Support:** Fully translated into English, Russian, German, and French! 🌍
* **Perfect for free hosting users:** If you frequently play on servers like `Aternos` or `Minehut` and constantly get the annoying "Connection reset" error, this mod will save your sanity! Just click one button to get right back into the action.

## 🚀 Supported Versions

* **Loader:** Fabric
* **Minecraft:** 1.21.11

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Make sure you have **Fabric Loader** installed.
2. Drop the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game and enjoy seamless rejoining!
